messages:
Avery Chen: Anyone up for a Redwood softball pick-up game this Saturday at 10am? Field at 4th & Pine. Everyone welcome! :baseball:
Samir Patel: I'm in. Can we get Alex and Maya? @Maya Thompson you in?
Maya Thompson: Heck yes. I'll bring a cooler. Do we need gloves? Maybe bring some for people.
Jordan Park: I can bring a bat and an extra glove. Also down for soccer if numbers low.
Priya Singh: Won't be able to make softball, but can referee/scorekeep. :raised_hands:
Avery Chen: Perfect — looks like we have enough for two teams. Plan: meet 9:30 to warm up, game starts 10. Follow-up: who's bringing sunscreen?
Samir Patel: I'll bring sunscreen and first-aid kit.
Maya Thompson: I'll bring cones and a speaker. Playlist suggestions welcome.
Alex Rivera: Rain forecast? I can bring a tarp and some umbrellas if needed.
Avery Chen: Weather app says 0% chance. If rain, we reschedule to Sunday same time. Reply with thumbs up if Sunday works too.
Jordan Park: +1
Priya Singh: :thumbsup:
Maya Thompson: :tada:
(Reaction: :soccer: by Jordan Park on "Also down for soccer if numbers low.")
